cases.name: Erika Belcourt
cases.about: She was a nurse. "She worked all day and went to school at night to make something of herself," said one neighbor who asked not to be identified. "She was a hard worker and a good mom."
cases.narrative: She suffered head trauma, along with massive cuts and broken bones throughout her body, and the car James Grilli used to drive over her left a “patterned tire tread” on the right side of her face.

cases.name: Tanya D. Gagnon
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Tanya worked as a Case Worker for Tills Group Home in Mass. for 27 years and also for Seven Hills in Woonsocket for several years.

She was a very caring and loving person her parents came first she always went above and beyond to help them. Tanya enjoyed her job taking care of her clients, going to the ocean, boating and Reggae music. But most of all she loved to spend time with family and friends. She also was an animal lover, her cat Leo, and dogs Kato and Baily. A quote from her dad "Tanya loved to eat and enjoyed having great dinners with him."
cases.narrative: On 6/17/2020, their bodies were found during a welfare check.
